scope: One identity projection/allocator over existing sources, with actual native fields for new normal captures

ownership.stateOwner: The existing championshipStandaloneApp; this module is pure and owns no state
existingSources: raising.assignments and raising.interactions keyed by the same instance ID

instanceIdentity.nextSequence: positive safe integer; strictly greater than every surviving generated ID ordinal

ownership.saveAuthority: Existing ChampionshipPersistentSavePort and championshipModernSave:v1 key; no additional roster copy or writer

api.canonicalRaisingSpeciesId: Remove only the existing championship:creature: presentation prefix; do not rewrite instance IDs
api.listRaisingInstances: Return an immutable ordered projection: starter first, then unmatched residents, then collection order
api.resolveRaisingInstance: Resolve one exact instance ID, return null if absent; never resolve by species
api.createRaisingInstanceIdentityState: New game or legacy migration: derive nextSequence from surviving generated IDs and assignment keys
api.normalizeRaisingInstanceIdentityState: Validate the one-field durable state and reject a mark behind the supplied sources
api.allocateRaisingInstanceIdentity: Return {state, instanceId}; the app commits both allocation state and existing collection mutation atomically

source.residentId: exact matching R2 resident ID or null
source.successAuthority: existing collection value or null; PRODUCT_AUTHORED_ENCLOSURE is not promoted to original capture

projection.interaction: Existing {careCount,lastCaredAt} or null; this is an interaction flag, not an original growth stat
projection.profile: Immutable per-individual HP/TP/species/personality/known stat projection when collection.nativeProfile exists; null for legacy/starter entries without it.
projection.profileEvidence: ROM_VERIFIED_INDIVIDUAL_FIELDS when nativeProfile exists; UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE otherwise.

invariants: Starter and resident references sharing the exact ID refer to one individual and must agree on canonical species ID
Two individuals of the same species keep independent IDs, names, cage memberships, sources and interactions
Duplicate resident IDs, duplicate collection IDs or collection/resident ID collisions are rejected by the resolver
Unknown IDs and missing profile fields remain unresolved; no species 0, base stats, preset team or rung fallback is added
Allocation is not capture: a reservation creates no collection member, changes no source, and applies no gameplay effect
New allocation uses championship:2026:instance: plus a decimal ordinal padded to at least four digits
The persisted high-water mark never decreases when collection members disappear
Numeric exhaustion and malformed or rewound current-schema marks are errors, not wraparound

Identity allocator serializes only its stable high-water mark. Actual known per-individual numeric fields may be stored inside the existing raising.collection entry; no forensic receipt, ROM payload or provenance blob is serialized.

legacyMigration.ids: Preserve all existing creatureId, residentId and instanceId values without renumbering
legacyMigration.ordinal: max decimal suffix among surviving generated IDs and assignment keys, plus one; start at one if none exist
legacyMigration.durableR2Compatibility: Allocator only reads IDs; durable R2 residents need not carry speciesId or name before restoration
legacyMigration.deletedHistory: Legacy envelopes did not persist deleted-ID history. No claim is made about unobserved IDs deleted before migration
legacyMigration.unknowns: Do not reconstruct original capture, starting selection, growth, current HP/TP, rungs, age or combat profile from species catalog values
legacyMigration.roundTrip: Once the v3 envelope is successfully saved, preserve its mark even if greater than the present roster maximum

evidence.supports: Existing research separates species definitions, encyclopedia state and individual instances; capture records an individual
evidence.limit: Research report structure only; no new ROM writer validation or current capture parity claim

evidence.supports: Collection, resident state and visible actor are separate concepts
evidence.limit: Retrieved classification does not independently promote the report to ROM_VERIFIED

evidence.supports: Existing implementation explicitly marks per-creature rung evidence UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE
evidence.limit: Known table/constructor arithmetic does not establish a player's persistent rung, current resources or mutation writers

evidence.supports: Current starter identity and FIRST_EGG_IN_TABLE_ORDER_UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE selection boundary
evidence.limit: Preservation of the current source is not verification that the original starts with that egg

notImplemented: Player party composition, eligibility and post-battle writeback
Original initial egg constructor/source and legacy profile reconstruction
Original name-edit charset and native record writer closure

currentNativeProfile.source: 108 known u32 fields plus5 narrow fields and source name copied by02061BB4; no padding
currentNativeProfile.legacyRule: Do not derive missing native profiles from species base stats or battle presets.
